data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 5.129 million in prior year reserves, representing an 8.25% increase relative to opening gross claims outstanding. This was primarily driven by adverse claims development and IBNR recalibration, particularly for the run-off years of account (2012-2014) which showed net losses. A specific favourable development was a GBP 1.1 million release of net claims from the 2016 Hurricane Matthew event.

data.data_quality_notes: The 'exact_reserve_text' describes net movements for specific years of account, while the 'prior_year_development_gbp_m' is derived from the gross claims development triangle, providing a more comprehensive gross figure. The RITC agreement for run-off years was effective Feb 2018, so the 2017 year-end triangle is considered valid for PYD calculation.
